scope: Confirmatory sources only. The main eight-source registry (configs/v431-r5/main_protocol_v2.json) is untouched; these two sources never participated in any development or selection.
split_ratio: 60/15/10/15 by row count with floor rounding, identical to main_protocol_v2.json; TRAIN region = train+dev, TEST region = calibration+test, mirroring src/introact_ts/v46/grid.py

grid.note: test30/test50/bankx2 are not run on the confirmatory set; train parents are tiled per segment at stride 704 from the segment start and the latest parent of each source is dropped as a purge buffer, mirroring v46/grid.py

sources.format: gzip text, no header, no timestamp column (2006 Alabama 137-channel 10-minute photovoltaic; absolute calendar not recovered, per docs/data_provenance_contract.md)
npz key 'values', float64 (9326, 40); channel 0 = FwdRate_Fitted_1Y; native missingness preserved (finite_fraction 0.9568), masks overlay native NaN cells, no prefilling
